notes: reading: A stated state or local tax refund is taxable in full: policyengine-us documents salt_refund_income as the taxable refund reported on Schedule 1, line 1 (26 U.S.C. 111). Alternative: the prior-year deduction's tax benefit (111(a)) is not stated, which would make none of it taxable.

reading: head (age 54) takes 384.00 of taxable IRA, SEP, 401(k) or 403(b) distributions. The additional tax on early distributions (26 U.S.C. 72(t)(1)) is 10% of a filer's taxable IRA, SEP, 401(k) and 403(b) distributions (qualified plans by their names, 4974(c)) when the filer is 59 or younger (a stated age of 59 does not state 59 1/2), less the medical exception (72(t)(2)(B): distributions up to medical expenses above 7.5% of AGI), and none for a filer disabled under 72(m)(7) (the is_disabled reading: stated disabled with no earnings of their own). Every other exception (separation from service after 55, equal periodic payments, first home, education, birth or adoption, and so on) needs an unstated fact, so none applies. A private pension is not taxed: whether the plan is a qualified plan (4974(c)) or an annuity contract (72(q)) is not stated. Tax-Calculator takes the tax as e09900; TAXSIM has no input for it. policyengine-us takes it as an input with no formula (qualified_retirement_penalty), so the key holds none; its line income_tax_before_refundable_credits adds it when stated.

itemized_notes: reading: Stated charitable gifts go to public charities (170(b)(1)(A) organizations): a private foundation is not stated. Non-cash gifts are ordinary-income property, deductible at the stated amount up to 50% of the contribution base less the cash allowed (170(b)(1)(A), (G)(iii)): no appreciation is stated, so none is capital gain property (170(b)(1)(C)). Cash counts up to 60% (170(b)(1)(G)); from 2026 only the total above 0.5% of the contribution base counts (170(b)(1)(I)). The excess over a ceiling carries forward five years; none is stated as carried in. Tax-Calculator applies its own ceilings (30% for non-cash gifts, 60% in all, after the floor); a note names a difference.
